head: codex/27-native-receipt-validator
title: fix(runtime): harden native receipt revision validation
body:
Closes #27

Makes Runtime v3 native receipt role denominators order-independent while preserving explicit uniqueness checks. Hardens post-proof revision validation with proof ancestry, rename-disabled Git path enumeration, immutable proof evidence, and fail-closed dirty-worktree handling. Adds real temporary-Git regressions for verifier-only repair, product dirtiness, rename attacks, and unrelated histories.

This is a stacked draft on WP-03. Focused policy validation, typed validation, diff hygiene, and exact-commit review pass. The final retained-packet integration remains intentionally deferred until WP-03 publishes its exact-head macOS and Linux native proofs; the current historical packet correctly fails with `runtime product changed after native proof`. Do not merge until that lane passes after rebasing onto terminal WP-03.
